eps_note: evaluator is exact and deterministic; 0.005 in log10|det| is a ~1.2% determinant gain

directives.EXPLOIT: One focused change to the current best construction.
directives.BOREDOM_SNAP: Stop re-tuning restarts/seed/budget; try a different search or construction method, grounded in a source (Exa) and checked against past.dev.
directives.PARADIGM_BREAKOUT: Change the mechanism: structured constructions (circulant/bordered blocks from the max-det literature) instead of local search.
directives.CONVERGED: Re-run the best construction to confirm the determinant.
